strengths: Mostly magazine cadence: short scenes, few stock “Japan is a country where” lines.
Useful concrete verbs (tuck the bag, step out of the stream, pocket a greasy bag).
Closing image (three steps out of the stream) is specific rather than slogan-like wonder.

issues.suggestion: Plain: it is a different situation / a different kind of public eating.
